code_08021DC4.c.why: The original reads the three incoming argument registers with ARM instructions; in C they are the parameters.

code_0801AAF8.c.why: Hand-encoded Thumb: r0 |= 16; r1 = -9; r0 &= r1. Sets bit 4 and clears bit 3.

code_08001A50.c.why: Online: the link task tells the network layer that the session ended, so the other players are told at once. The call to MultiSioStop sits in the same file as its definition, where a linker wrap does not reach.
